name: overseer
description: Watch and steer every subagent: live model and effort, change them mid-run, message running or finished agents, and run Codex as a steerable subagent.

autoOpenPane.title: Open the Agents pane on the first subagent
autoOpenPane.description: Opens the pane beside the chat when a subagent starts. It never takes focus.

informParent.title: Tell Claude about your messages
informParent.description: When you message a subagent, add a note to the main conversation so Claude trusts what the subagent reports.

autoRevive.title: Revive agents a bad override broke
autoRevive.description: If a model override fails a request, drop the override and tell the agent to continue.

redirectCodexBash.title: Send Codex runs through Overseer
redirectCodexBash.description: Refuse raw `codex exec` shell commands and point Claude at the Overseer Codex tool, so you can watch and steer them.

codexSandbox.title: Codex access
codexSandbox.description: What Codex may do when Overseer runs it.

codexPath.title: Codex executable
codexPath.description: Absolute path to codex. Empty finds it automatically.

spawnReview.title: Review subagent prompts before they start
spawnReview.description: Hold each new subagent until you approve, edit or deny its prompt in the pane.

spawnReviewTimeoutSec.title: Spawn review timeout (seconds)
spawnReviewTimeoutSec.description: An unanswered review approves itself after this long, so unattended runs never hang.

historyDays.title: Days of agent history to keep
historyDays.description: Finished agents from earlier sessions, shown under History.
